_comment: Mock-mode topics. topic_id = the Qualtrics block name. topic_text values are DRAFT wordings (Claude-written, ProCon-style) to be replaced with the survey's exact statements. Entries without their own corpus_sources/<topic_id>/ directory are cloned from clone_from's timelines when building the mock corpus (npm run build:corpus:mock). IDs must match the TOPICS list in docs/qualtrics/question.js.

topics.topic_text: Should Halloween be moved to the last Saturday of October?
Should historical statues of controversial figures be removed from public spaces?
Are ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft good for society?
Are the Olympic Games an overall benefit for their host countries and cities?
Should Election Day be a national holiday?
Should students have to recite the Pledge of Allegiance in school?
Should fighting be allowed in hockey?
Should tablets replace textbooks in K-12 schools?
Should the US government pay reparations for slavery?
Do violent video games contribute to youth violence?
Should net neutrality rules be restored?
Should the US require mandatory national service?
Is cancel culture good for society?
Should books be banned from school libraries?
